posts.title: You are the algorithm
posts.description: On the Social Web (also known as The Fediverse or Mastodon), the saying goes that “you are the algorithm”, usually to mean that, because the software that connects you with other people is not profiling you, it’s your active contributions, the posts you share to your followers, that helps propagate information.
